sources.title: Mixtral of experts — original release announcement
sources.evidence: Dated December 11, 2023; releases Mixtral 8x7B Instruct alongside the base model. Describes sparse decoder-only architecture with two of eight experts per layer, 46.7B total and 12.9B parameters used per token, 32k context, Apache 2.0 open weights, and Instruct training using SFT and DPO.

sources.title: Mixtral-8x7B-Instruct-v0.1 official model card at eba9230
sources.evidence: Exact checkpoint card names its Mixtral-8x7B-v0.1 base, Apache 2.0 license, released weights, instruction format and text-generation examples. Its reference inference explicitly uses MistralTokenizer.v1().

sources.title: Mixtral-8x7B-Instruct-v0.1 configuration at eba9230
sources.evidence: Exact Instruct checkpoint declares MixtralForCausalLM/model_type mixtral, 32 layers, eight local experts with two selected per token, max_position_embeddings 32768, no sliding window, text vocabulary 32000, BF16 weights and untied word embeddings.

sources.title: Mixtral of Experts — technical report
sources.evidence: Describes the Transformer MoE architecture and its Instruct fine-tune; gives 47B total/13B active nominal counts, Table 1 context_len 32768 and explicitly supported dense 32k context, plus open Apache 2.0 release for both base and Instruct.

sources.title: Mixtral 8x7B official model specifications
sources.evidence: Exact Instruct Weights row links Mixtral-8x7B-Instruct-v0.1 and explicitly lists Parameters (B) 47, Active (B) 13, Apache 2.0, and 32k token context. The release date is December 11, 2023. API retirement is separately documented.

sources.title: Pinned official Mixtral 8x7B specification source
sources.evidence: At cd2192e the Instruct Weights entry links this exact checkpoint and records parameters 47, active 13, contextSize 32k and Apache 2.0. Model capabilities explicitly list text input/text output. Empty features do not expressly classify dedicated reasoning.

sources.title: Pinned official weights-table renderer
sources.evidence: The parameters and active source properties are rendered under Parameters (B) and Active (B), establishing billion-parameter units separately from GPU RAM.

sources.title: Pinned official InstructTokenizerV1 implementation
sources.evidence: InstructTokenizerV1 expressly does not support tools, images or audio; encode_tool_message and assistant messages containing tool_calls raise TokenizerException. This establishes lack of native tool protocol for the V1 reference tokenizer, not inability to follow externally wrapped text instructions.

sources.title: Pinned official MistralTokenizer V1 factory
sources.evidence: MistralTokenizer.v1 loads tokenizer.model.v1; the V1 branch constructs InstructTokenizerV1. This connects the exact checkpoint card reference tokenizer to the explicit unsupported-tools implementation.

name.note: Readable form of the exact released checkpoint identifier; retains Instruct and v0.1.

developer.note: Mistral AI releases and publishes this checkpoint; preserve the catalog developer label.

family.note: Normalize the Mixtral lineage: this Instruct checkpoint identifies Mixtral-8x7B-v0.1 as its base and its configuration uses model_type mixtral. Mistral is the developer and broader brand.

release_date.note: Original dated launch explicitly releases the Instruct model alongside the base model; the later official specification agrees.

open_weights.note: Developer release and exact official downloadable Instruct weights establish open weights.

license.note: Exact Instruct card and weights row specify Apache 2.0; the paper explicitly includes both base and Instruct.

parameters_b.note: Retain developer launch precision: 46.7 billion total parameters. The exact Instruct configuration matches the published Mixtral architecture, and its official weights row independently reports the consistent whole-billion nominal count 47B. Neither value is 8 multiplied by 7B; no exact tensor-count claim is made.

active_parameters_b.note: Developer launch explicitly states 12.9B parameters used per token; exact Instruct configuration selects two of eight experts per layer. Its separate official Active (B) entry rounds to 13B. These are nominal developer disclosures, not an expert-name multiplication.

architecture.note: Sparse decoder-only Transformer mixture of experts; the exact configuration has eight experts per layer with two routed per token.

context_window.note: Supported 32k context is stated for the exact Instruct weights; paper Table 1 specifies 32768 and explicitly describes dense supported context. Exact config agrees. This is not inferred only from maximum positional embeddings.

modalities.note: Official capabilities explicitly specify text input/output; exact card demonstrates text generation with its V1 tokenizer.

reasoning.note: Reviewed first-party sources describe instruction tuning and benchmark reasoning, but do not explicitly classify this exact checkpoint as supporting or lacking a dedicated reasoning mode. Empty feature metadata and absence of a thinking-token protocol do not establish false; clear the unsupported baseline flag.

tool_call.note: Native tool calling is unsupported in the exact card reference V1 tokenizer: official implementation explicitly rejects tool messages and assistant tool_calls. This does not exclude external prompt templates, constrained decoding or wrappers that emulate function calls.

description.value: Open sparse mixture-of-experts Mistral instruction model
description.note: Concise description is supported by the official open-weight release and instruction fine-tuning account.

patch.notes: Developer-disclosed nominal counts are 46.7B total and 12.9B active per token; the exact Instruct weights specification rounds these to 47B and 13B. Native tool calling is unsupported by the official V1 tokenizer; external wrappers are separate. Dedicated reasoning classification remains unverified.

summary: Confirmed original 2023-12-11 Instruct release, Apache 2.0 open weights, 46.7B total/12.9B active nominal counts (official Instruct row rounds to 47B/13B), sparse MoE architecture, 32768-token supported context and text modalities. Normalize family to mixtral. Preserve native tool_call=false with explicit official V1 tokenizer evidence. Clear unsupported reasoning=false to null; no exact dedicated reasoning classification was established.
